title: Classify offshore infrastructure using multimodal 6-month SAR+optical 100×100 tiles (ConvNeXt)
description: Classify detected offshore structures using a ConvNeXt-based multi-input/single-output CNN. Inputs are two 100×100 tiles centered on each structure: (1) 6-month composite dual-band SAR (VH,VV) at ~20 m/pixel; (2) 6-month composite optical RGB+NIR at ~10 m/pixel. Two independent branches process SAR and optical tiles, concatenate features, and output class probabilities: wind, oil, other infrastructure, noise. If optical tiles are unavailable (e.g., seasonal darkness), classification uses SAR only (optical blank).

outputs.infrastructure_labels: Class probabilities + predicted class per structure
